g.text: MinVelRank1Convo1 begins.

g.title: j3299278770
g.text: MomToxicated: What's happened to her? I need answers.

g.title: j2736961808
g.text: MomToxicated: Real answers. And none of this "it's hard to explain" bullshit the other ones are giving me.

g.title: j665321640
g.text: Lol.

g.title: j2387730058
g.text: Hi?

g.title: j2299847043
g.text: Um.

g.title: j129507053
g.text: And this is...?

g.title: j1789947603
g.text: PapaPolar: no reason to be like that. start with a "hi, how are ya?"

g.title: j1114887677
g.text: PapaPolar: sorry, pal. when M's got a target in sight, it's all about the Go Go Go.

g.title: j2992383815
g.text: MomToxicated: And I don't need YOU undercutting me.

g.title: j4044286221
g.text: PapaPolar: i'm not?

g.title: j2869771966
g.text: MomToxicated: Hah. Yeah. Right. Like you weren't undercutting me in Yalchesko.

g.title: j2645365900
g.text: Minerva & Velimir, I assume?

g.title: j3780885349
g.text: Okay... Can we back up, please? What's going on?

g.title: j2362552461
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah. sorry. hi. i was probably the easy one to guess, huh? lol

g.title: j2093162414
g.text: PapaPolar: hah! sorry, pal. velimir. and MomToxicated over here is minerva.

g.title: j747213199
g.text: PapaPolar: MomToxicated over here is minerva.

g.title: j1496943431
g.text: MomToxicated: VELIMIR. What is the POINT of using this asset if YOU JUST -

g.title: j3497443553
g.text: MomToxicated: DAMN IT.

g.title: j3598636832
g.text: PapaPolar: M, be reasonable. process of elimination. how many of us freaks can there reasonably be on this system?

g.title: j1808275062
g.text: I get the feeling there are going to just end up being more and more as time goes on.

g.title: j3398075474
g.text: Can you two sort out whatever is happening and *then* come talk to me?

g.title: j3583452332
g.text: I am so extremely confused.

g.title: j1715989729
g.text: Boolean VelimirFamily1 is now true.

g.title: j3134152288
g.text: PapaPolar: fear you'll be waiting a long time then, pal. hah.

g.title: j999981004
g.text: PapaPolar: well, if *you're* confused, then we're all screwed. hah!

g.title: j3935735381
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1675418053
g.text: PapaPolar: here's the short of it. M here has questions she wants answers to, and wants you to answer them.

g.title: j2826830537
g.text: PapaPolar: seeing as you're the one we've come here to get answers from.

g.title: j1620150799
g.text: PapaPolar: i for one hope so! the more the merrier, i say. s'like the old saying goes, the only difference between a cult and a religion is numbers, haha.

g.title: j1995963863
g.text: PapaPolar: there. that better, M? that suit your "good cop/bad cop" gameplan more?

g.title: j2697706592
g.text: PapaPolar: is that a saying?

g.title: j978534354
g.text: MomToxicated: Sol above, I'm going to scream...

g.title: j2171838871
g.text: PapaPolar: i don't know. you get where i'm going. water's great, everybody in, as far as i'm concerned! well, anyway.

g.title: j2008725258
g.text: Why do I get the feeling I'm being interrogated?

g.title: j4085568564
g.text: Well. Um. I'd rather if you didn't try to "game" the conversation with me.

g.title: j1765324056
g.text: What do you have questions about? I'll help if I can.

g.title: j3142983299
g.text: MomToxicated: Not a word, Velimir.

g.title: j4076655874
g.text: MomToxicated: This is anything but a game.

g.title: j1935233953
g.text: MomToxicated: Your cooperation has been noted, "Drifter."

g.title: j3678438172
g.text: PapaPolar: :-X

g.title: j3058530215
g.text: MomToxicated: Are you going to answer my questions? Yes or no?

g.title: j4139660192
g.text: MomToxicated: If that is your real name.

g.title: j1262027233
g.text: MomToxicated: Like dealing with - whatever. Whatever. It doesn't matter.

g.title: j2376920290
g.text: Nah, sorry. I don't like your attitude, lady.

g.title: j3135270320
g.text: Okay, fine. What is it?

g.title: j304980477
g.text: PapaPolar: (i don't think we get to judge.)

g.title: j1511912128
g.text: MomToxicated: A mistake. I will give you some time to think it over and reconsider.

g.title: j4196497862
g.text: MomToxicated: VELIMIR

g.title: j1805198523
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1706378817
g.text: PapaPolar: :-X

j3929619251
g.text: MomToxicated: Drifter.

g.title: j593008253
g.text: MomToxicated: One simple question answered, and we will be on our way:

g.title: j4058717872
g.text: MomToxicated: What has happened to Major Neci Rusalka?

g.title: j3639801146
g.text: It's... complicated?

g.title: j4039013660
g.text: I... don't know.

g.title: j2286635253
g.text: MomToxicated: "COMPLICATED."

g.title: j3613152070
g.text: MomToxicated: You "DON'T KNOW."

g.title: j2119538045
g.text: PapaPolar: oh, here we go...

g.title: j757058461
g.text: MomToxicated: Drifter. You and I will continue this tomorrow. Velimir. You. Me. A word. Offline.

g.title: j408309343
g.text: MomToxicated: NOW.
